property_summary: Invariant: calling owned() must not change owner when the caller is not the current owner; the mutant removes the onlyOwner check so a non-owner caller can call owned() and (via a crafted calldata that performs a delegatecall-style state write if owned were writable) change owner — we instead target that only the current owner can successfully call transferOwnership to change owner, so any call to transferOwnership by a non-owner must not change c.owner(); the mutant allowing non-owner execution of owner-only functions would permit a non-owner to change owner via transferOwnership and thus break this rule.
change_summary: Replace onlyOwner modifier body to remove the require, allowing owned() to be called by anyone and potentially change owner if owned() sets it.
